description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector_DisplayLinkURI' which modifies how link URLs are displayed in HTML content, replacing link hrefs with plain text showing the URL.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_DisplayLinkURI
classes.description: An injector class that alters 'a' elements to display their URL instead of creating a hyperlink.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles the opening of an element; currently empty, possibly to be implemented later.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of an element; replaces the 'href' attribute with its URL inside parentheses in the token stream.
